collection.title: Aston Martin DBS Coupe 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Aston Martin DBS 2020 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
